name: Certification label (silver polyester)
where_seen: The compliance label on the driver's door edge, hinge pillar or door-latch post, carrying the maker, build month, weight ratings and the VIN.
texture: Flat matte-silver film with a faint horizontal brushed sheen; block capitals at least 3/32 in (2.4 mm) high in a colour that contrasts with the background, set in ruled rows, about 10 cm by 2 cm for a bare VIN label.
css: background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.35), rgba(255,255,255,0) 40%, rgba(0,0,0,.06)), repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,.08) 0 1px, rgba(0,0,0,.03) 1px 2px), #C9CCCE;
unverified: base hex (visual estimate; the rule fixes only contrast and letter height)

name: Tire and loading placard
where_seen: The tire pressure placard on the driver's door jamb, headed 'Tire and Loading Information'.
texture: Flat glossy white label in ruled table cells with a black header band and yellow emphasis; colour and format are fixed by a figure in the standard, not by text.
css: background: linear-gradient(#000 0 1.6em, transparent 1.6em), repeating-linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0 calc(2em - 1px), #000 calc(2em - 1px) 2em), #FFFFFF;
unverified: exact yellow/black/white arrangement (Figure 1 is an image; a proposal describes yellow text on black)

name: Safety-yellow warning label
where_seen: Caution and warning labels on sun visors, battery covers, radiator shrouds and jack points.
texture: Flat, saturated, semi-gloss vinyl; yellow marks caution, orange marks warning, red marks danger; black sans-serif capitals in a signal-word panel above the message.
unverified: hex values are screen approximations of the Pantone 109 C / 151 C references; the standard defines the colours by Munsell and CIE chromaticity, and safety orange is also given as #FF7900

name: Zinc yellow chromate hardware
where_seen: Plated bolts, brackets, brake fittings and hose clamps across the engine bay and chassis.
texture: Satin metallic gold with an iridescent rainbow cast that drifts to greenish yellow and pink across the surface.
unverified: all hex values (visual estimates; sources give only 'iridescent, greenish-yellow, rainbow')

name: Dyed anodised aluminium
where_seen: Hose fittings, fuel rail fittings, strut-top hardware and aftermarket caps, most often in blue, red, black or clear.
texture: Translucent dye in a sealed oxide layer over machined metal, so the colour reads as tinted metal with a soft satin band of highlight; shade varies with film thickness, dye concentration and alloy.
css: background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.28), rgba(255,255,255,0) 30%, rgba(0,0,0,.18) 70%, rgba(255,255,255,.10)), repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,.05) 0 1px, transparent 1px 3px), #1F4E9E;
unverified: use on hose fittings (no source found)

name: Aluminium diamond tread plate
where_seen: Truck bed toolboxes, running boards, trailer decks and shop floors.
texture: Bright polished sheet with raised elongated diamonds in a four-way pattern on roughly 1 in (25 mm) centres, each lug at right angles to its neighbours.
css: background: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, rgba(255,255,255,.55) 0 3px, transparent 3px 25px), repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, rgba(0,0,0,.14) 0 3px, transparent 3px 25px), linear-gradient(180deg, #C8CCD0, #A9AEB3);

name: Steel pegboard
where_seen: The tool wall behind a workbench.
texture: Painted or galvanised 20-gauge sheet with round holes of 1/4 in to 9/32 in on a square 1 in (25.4 mm) grid; low sheen.
unverified: base hex (RAL 7001 silver grey is used as a stand-in; panels are sold in several colours)

name: Perforated speaker grille
texture: Black-finished sheet with round holes in 60-degree staggered rows; a 3/32 in hole on 5/32 in centres gives about 33 percent open area (calculated).
unverified: the 3/32-on-5/32 pattern as typical for vehicles (a common stock pattern; open area is arithmetic, not sourced)

name: Carbon fibre 2x2 twill
where_seen: Trim inlays, mirror caps, splitters and engine covers under a clear gloss coat.
texture: Diagonal stair-step weave of 3K tows at about 5 ends per cm (roughly 2 mm pitch) under high-gloss clear; alternating tows catch the light as light and dark grey.
css: background: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, rgba(255,255,255,.10) 0 2px, transparent 2px 4px), repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, rgba(0,0,0,.45) 0 2px, transparent 2px 4px), linear-gradient(180deg, #2A2A2D, #121214);
unverified: 2 mm pitch is derived from the 5 ends/cm figure

name: Glass frit band and dot fade
where_seen: The black border around a windshield or rear window, fading into the clear glass through rows of shrinking dots, with the maker's monogram in a lower corner.
texture: Matte black ceramic enamel fused to the glass; a halftone of dots that shrink toward the clear area; the corner monogram (maker code, 'AS1', approval marks) reads as pale grey frosted lettering.
css: background: linear-gradient(180deg, #0B0B0C 0 60%, transparent 60%), radial-gradient(circle, #0B0B0C 0 2px, transparent 2.2px) 0 0 / 6px 6px, linear-gradient(180deg, #DDE6E4, #C9D4D2);

name: Analogue gauge face
where_seen: Speedometer and tachometer dials in the instrument cluster.
texture: Flat matte black dial with white numerals and tick marks that are backlit at night, and a single orange or red pointer.
css: background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #F4F4F0 0 1px, transparent 1px 12px) 0 100% / 100% 6px no-repeat, radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 0%, #1E1E1E, #0D0D0D 70%);
unverified: hex values (the pointer orange borrows the safety-orange approximation)

name: Vacuum-fluorescent display
where_seen: Dashboard clocks, radio displays and digital clusters of the 1980s and 1990s.
texture: Glowing blue-green segments (zinc oxide phosphor, peak near 505 nm) behind dark filter glass, with a faint mesh of fine grid wires in front.
css: background: repeating-linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.035) 0 1px, transparent 1px 3px), radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 50%, rgba(92,242,208,.08), transparent 70%), #0A1210;
unverified: hex values (screen approximations of a 505 nm blue-green)

name: Reflective segment LCD
where_seen: Odometer and trip-meter windows in the cluster.
texture: Flat grey reflective panel with black seven-segment digits and faint ghosts of the unlit segments.
unverified: hex values; sources say 'black on grey', the green cast is an estimate

name: Blueprint (cyanotype)
where_seen: Engineering drawings of parts and assemblies.
texture: Matte Prussian-blue paper with white lines and lettering, slightly uneven in tone, often with a ruled grid.
css: background: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(255,255,255,.07) 0 1px, transparent 1px 16px), repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,.07) 0 1px, transparent 1px 16px), #003153;

name: Red oxide primer
where_seen: Bare floor pans, chassis rails and body shells before top coat.
texture: Dead-flat, chalky brown-red (RAL 3009 oxide red) with no highlight.
unverified: that vehicle primers match RAL 3009 (the RAL name is the nearest standard reference)

name: Reflective license plate
where_seen: The registration plate at the rear of the vehicle.
texture: Retroreflective white sheeting with a fine sparkle over a 12 in by 6 in aluminium blank; characters about 2.5 to 2.75 in high, embossed up to 1.7 mm and inked on their raised faces, with a raised rim.
unverified: the national standard's own character-height text was not retrieved

name: Black wrinkle powder coat
where_seen: Valve covers, intake plenums and older dashboard tops.
texture: Low-gloss black with a fine, tight crinkle of small ridges that scatters highlights and hides casting flaws.
css: background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, rgba(255,255,255,.07) 0 1px, transparent 1.5px) 0 0 / 5px 4px, radial-gradient(circle at 70% 60%, rgba(0,0,0,.6) 0 1px, transparent 1.6px) 2px 1px / 4px 5px, #161616;

name: Exploded-view parts page
where_seen: The illustrated parts catalogue and shop manual: an isometric line drawing with numbered callouts beside a parts list.
texture: Matte off-white paper with thin black line art, dashed axis lines, leader lines that never cross and numbered balloons keyed to a table whose index starts at 1.
css: background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 2.4em, #111 2.4em calc(2.4em + 1px), transparent calc(2.4em + 1px)), repeating-linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0 calc(1.8em - 1px), rgba(0,0,0,.35) calc(1.8em - 1px) 1.8em), #F4F1E8;
